avgTip:
Your average
What came in minus what went out, in each of the last full months, then averaged.
**Not counted:** transfers between your own accounts, card bill payments (the purchases themselves are counted), upcoming payments and rows you left out.
**This month** is not counted until it is over.
The number of months follows **Based on** at the top of the page.
It can differ from **Saved each month** in the table above: the table also counts this month, with what usually still comes, and evens out unusual months to look ahead.
start: It starts from {start} in your accounts today.
startG: It starts from {start} in your accounts today and grows {pc}% a year.
startTip:
In your accounts
Bank and wallet money today, the same as on Home.
Pension is not included.
noAge: Add your age to see this by age. Until then, it counts in years from today.
playNote: Only for trying. Nothing here changes your data.
mTip:
Set aside each month
Starts at your average ({amount}).
Change it to see what a different amount would do.
gTip:
Growth each year
Money kept in savings or investments can grow over the years.
**3–5%** a year is common for long-term investing.
It is only a guess: it can be more, less, or even go down.
**0%:** the money just sits.
